pages.title: Bioluminescent Membrane
pages.text: A membrane full of luciferase, glowing as a firefly does: light made by a living thing. Found in the landmarks of Inner Space. In the Photobioreactor its light grows algae; four Cell Membranes and glowstone dust (or an Eel Photophore) make more.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inner Space.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Algae Culture.
